purpose: Teach: 短歌/防水/漁船/対岸/華人/バード/初演/見渡す

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: 若い頃、本気で、絶対、短歌、二人で、よく、詠んだわよな、ばあさん、覚えてる?本気で、本当に、絶対、思い出深い、本気、絶対。
lines.en: When we were young, we really did write tanka together often, didn't we, gran? Do you remember? Those days stick with me.
lines.style: Soft, reaching backward in time. Voice settles on the memory itself. Warm but tinged with the weight of years. Gentle questioning, not doubt.

lines.speaker: sachiko_grandma
lines.jp: うん。お祖父ちゃん、本気で、防水の腕時計、絶対、長年、使っていたわよね、覚えてる、あなた?本気で、絶対、思い出、本当に、絶対、本気。
lines.en: Yes. Your grandfather—he wore that waterproof watch for so many years, you know? I remember it so clearly, dear. Such precious times with him.
lines.style: Responding with her own layer of memory. Soft and present. Voice lingers slightly on 'watch'—the small object that held years. Genuine, unhurried.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: 昔、本気で、漁船、絶対、二人で、よく、見たわよな、ばあさん、覚えてる?本気で、本当に、ロマンチック、絶対、本気、絶対、本気で。
lines.en: Back then, we used to watch the fishing boats go by so often, remember? Those quiet moments between us.
lines.style: Voice drifts into the scene itself. Slower pace. Breathing space between phrases. The boats are almost visible in how he says it.

lines.speaker: sachiko_grandma
lines.jp: 若い頃、川の対岸、本気で、絶対、二人で、デート、したわよね、覚えてる、あなた?本気で、本当に、ロマンチック、絶対、本気、本気、絶対。
lines.en: When we were young, we'd go on dates to the other side of the river, remember? It was so romantic, those times with you.
lines.style: Voice brightens slightly—she's right there with him now. Warmth underlying the words. Small smile in the delivery. The river is right there.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: 若い頃、お祖父ちゃん、本気で、華人の友達、絶対、たくさん、いたんだよな、ばあさん、覚えてる?本気で、絶対、本気で、本当に、絶対、本気。
lines.en: When I was young, you had so many Chinese friends, didn't you? I remember that about you.
lines.style: Quieter turn. Slight wondering tone—noticing something about him from long ago. Voice is tender but specific, calling back a detail that mattered.

lines.speaker: sachiko_grandma
lines.jp: 若い頃、本気で、絶対、バードウォッチング、二人で、よく、行ったわよね、覚えてる、あなた?本気で、絶対、楽しかった、絶対、本気、本気で。
lines.en: We used to go birdwatching together so often when we were young, don't you remember? Those were such happy times.
lines.style: Light lift in her voice—this memory makes her happy. Natural, conversational warmth. Not performing joy, but genuinely pleased to recall it.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: 息子の劇、本気で、絶対、初演、家族で、行ったよな、ばあさん、覚えてる?本気で、本当に、感動した
lines.en: Our son's play—we went to the premiere together as a family, didn't we? That opening night. I was so moved.
lines.style: Voice slows on 'premiere.' Real emotion surfaces here—this matters. Not overwhelming, but genuine. The pride and feeling of that night is in the delivery.

lines.speaker: sachiko_grandma
lines.jp: 若い頃、屋上から、本気で、絶対、街を、見渡すことが、できたわよね、覚えてる、あなた?本気で、本当に、ロマンチック、絶対、本気、本気で、本当に、絶対。
lines.en: From the rooftop when we were young, we could see the whole town stretched out before us, remember? It was so beautiful, so romantic.
lines.style: Voice opens outward—she's painting the view. Slower, more expansive. Lets the ending breathe. A full, satisfied memory. No rush to close it.
